messages:
Ava: Heads up — draft for launch-week email plan. We're gating the webinar sign-up behind a short nurture (3 emails) + a benchmark report download. Want low blast risk and high deliverability. Thoughts on segmentation and timing?
Priya: Love the gated approach. Suggest two nurture tracks: product-focused and case-study-focused, split by signup_source. Also want 2 subject-line variants per track for A/B.
Liam: Regional send windows: APAC => 09:30 JST / 10:30 AEST, EMEA => 11:00 GMT, NA => 10:00 PT. Stagger sends by region to avoid infra spikes.
Diego: Deliverability note — warm IPs and throttle initial batches. Recommend starting at 3k/min for APAC and 8k/min for NA, ramp after 24h. Include List-Unsubscribe header + proper DKIM alignment.
Sam: HubSpot can handle the branching on contact.signup_source and waits. I'll scaffold the flow and share a preview. Also confirm we have the benchmark PDF and short landing form.
Priya: Subject options (track=product): A1) "New: Faster inference for production teams" A2) "Benchmark: inference cost down 3x" — we'll A/B test across random seeds.
Ava: I'll draft a 2-3 sentence benchmark narrative blurb for email #1 and circulate. Keep it punchy: metric, short customer quote, CTA to download.
Liam: Webinar gating flow idea: immediate confirmation email after register (calendar + receipt), email #2 (48h) sends report + recording link option. Keep confirmation instant.
Diego: Soft resend for non-opens at 72h with refreshed subject line. Also pre-send seedlist checks for spammy content and image-to-text ratio.
Sam: I created the assets folder (internal): /assets/launch/benchmarks. Please upload final PDF and hero image. HubSpot flow pseudocode I will implement: 
```
# pseudo
send_batch(region='APAC', rate=3000/min)
wait(30m)
send_batch(region='EMEA', rate=5000/min)
wait(30m)
send_batch(region='NA', rate=8000/min)
```
Priya: Tracking — UTMs: campaign=bench-launch, source=email, variant=A/B. Set conversion event on webinar_register and report_download. Segment clicks on CTA for SDR routing.
Ava: Deadline: first draft copy by tomorrow 3pm PT. Can everyone review by then? :pray:
Diego: On it. I'll also run deliverability preflight once copy is in.
Liam: Yep, will check regional language/tones.
Priya: Will finalize subject variants and alt preview text.
Sam: I'll wire the HubSpot branches and post preview links once copy and assets are in.
Ava: Quick product question — include 'attend live' vs 'watch recording' CTA split in email #2?
Priya: Yes. Split links so clicks on 'attend live' mark high-intent; route to SDR queue for follow-up.
Diego: I'll run seedlist opens/stats before main send. If any spam traps trip, we pause.
Ava: Great — I'll upload the blurb + one-pager to Drive now and ping here when done :rocket:
